serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Not too shabby.
You: Honestly it’s quite a lot better than I expected.
The room itself was quite small and it was one of those compact bathrooms where the entire floor was slightly slanted with a single drain. The tiles were gray and dull, but…
It was my own bathroom!
That’s amazing!
Bot: You look happy {f_playerName}!
You: Yes! I really am!
You: Oh! There’s even some unopened soap here!
I wouldn’t expect the landlord to leave amenities like this. I think…
He probably didn’t even bother to check. Lucky for us! 
I guess if you consider how much I paid for this bathroom it’s not that lucky…
Anyway.
